items.stem: A hook that must stop a bad edit from completing should be:

options.text: A blocking hook whose non-zero exit prevents the action
options.rationale: Correct: enforcement requires a blocking hook, not an advisory note.

options.text: An advisory message the user may ignore
options.rationale: An advisory hook cannot enforce the policy.
A comment does not actively block an action.
A manual step is not automatic enforcement.

items.stem: Which TWO properties should a good Claude Code hook have? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Fast enough not to disrupt normal work
options.rationale: Correct: slow hooks block every action and frustrate use.

options.text: Deterministic and safe to run repeatedly
options.rationale: Correct: idempotent, deterministic hooks are reliable.

options.text: Runs the entire slow test suite on every keystroke
options.rationale: Heavy work on every event belongs in CI, not a hook.

items.explanation: Correct: slow hooks block every action and frustrate use.

options.rationale: Correct: a slow or hanging hook blocks the actions it wraps.
